summary: Iteration 4 end-to-end tested payment methods CRUD, member wallet 3-page split (hub/topup/transactions), order status filters (awaiting_info/waiting/completed/pending_payment), and admin 支付管理 tab. Backend pytest: 16/16 PASS (public /api/payment-methods masks config, 5 seeded methods present inc. 信用卡/Apple Pay/Google Pay/PayPal/USDT/銀行轉帳; admin CRUD masks api_key to sk_l••••56; PUT with masked value preserves original secret verified by follow-up public topup; 400 for bad category/provider/missing name; member 403 on admin endpoint; wallet topup below min_usd=5 → 400; valid topup credits balance, sets last_method_id, note contains method name; unknown method_id → 400; inactive method → 400; order filter awaiting_info / waiting / completed / pending_payment behave correctly; delete 200). Frontend Playwright: /account/wallet hub shows wallet-balance, wallet-go-topup, wallet-go-transactions, wallet-last-tx; sidebar 我的錢包 (account-nav-account-wallet) stays highlighted on subpages; wallet-back navigates to hub; top-up page pm-category-tabs with pm-cat-all/card/ewallet/bank filters pm-grid; clicking card sets aria-pressed=true, shows pm-description with method name; topup-preset-20 + topup-submit credits wallet (verified balance $663.02 → $683.02); after reload pm-recent-* badge shown on last-used method; /account/wallet/transactions tx-tab-all/in/out filter correctly (all + rows positive, all - rows negative); /orders tabs order-filter-all/pending_payment/awaiting_info/waiting/completed each render only matching 等待填寫資料 / 等待中 / 已完成 cards; admin → admin-nav-payments lists 5 rows, pm-add-btn + form (name/category=bank/description/provider=manual/cfg-account_info) + pm-form-save adds row; pm-toggle flips 啟用中/已停用 and the method disappears from public /api/payment-methods; pm-edit prefills form; pm-delete (window.confirm handled) removes row.

test_results.admin_put_masked_preserves_secret: PASS (follow-up topup still works, admin GET still masked)

critical_code_review_comments: sidebar testid naming is account-nav-account-wallet (not sidebar-wallet). Review spec hinted sidebar-wallet; current naming is consistent across sidebar entries (account-nav-*) so acceptable, but worth standardising docs.
PaymentMethodsAdmin edit form has no explicit cancel button in the inline form — closing requires save (OK since save is idempotent, but a 取消 button would be nicer).
WalletTopUp success does not refresh the pm-recent badge until a reload; consider revalidating useWallet() immediately after successful top-up for instant 最近使用 feedback.
admin uses window.confirm for pm-delete and other destructive actions — consistent with other admin pages but still a UX gap (not themeable).
